criteria.Pr_15 Preparatory products: Ground and site preparation products: soil stabilizers, excavated earth and fill, geotextiles, geomembranes and geocells, trench boards and sheets, fill blocks. Seldom a Revit family
criteria.Pr_20 Structure and general products: Load-bearing and general building products: metal, timber and precast sections for beams and columns, masonry and structural units, piles, lintels, trusses and frames, brackets, hangers and fasteners such as bolts and anchors. Revit: Structural Columns, Structural Framing, Structural Foundations
criteria.Pr_25 Skin products: Products that form or line the building skin: cladding and lining panels, boards and sheets, membranes, insulation, glazing sheets, handrails, stair and ladder units, floor gratings, smoke and fire barriers and fire-stopping. Revit: Curtain Panels, Railings
criteria.Pr_30 Opening products: Openings and their parts: doorsets, door frames and leaves, window units, rooflights, hatches and access panels in walls and floors, gates and barriers, shutters, blinds, louvres, wall and door ventilation grilles, and door and window hardware. Revit: Doors, Windows
criteria.Pr_35 Covering and finishing products: Coverings and finishes: paints and coatings, plasters and renders, carpets and floor coverings, wall and floor tiles, ceiling infill units, trims, flashings, joints and sealing strips
criteria.Pr_40 Signage, sanitary fittings and fit: Signs; sanitary fittings such as WCs, urinals, washbasins, sinks, baths, showers and taps; fitted desks, seats, shelving and storage; loose furniture such as desks, chairs, beds and bins; fire extinguishers and fire blankets; kitchen, laundry, medical, office and sports equipment. Revit: Furniture, Casework, Plumbing Fixtures, Specialty Equipment
criteria.Pr_45 Flora and fauna products: Plants and animals: trees, shrubs, seeds, turf, topsoil and growing media, plant containers and supports, animal passes and deterrents. Revit: Planting
criteria.Pr_50 Fabric accessory products: Fabric accessory products. Uniclass group title only: version 1.43 publishes no subgroups under it
criteria.Pr_55 Manufacturing process products: Manufacturing process products; in version 1.43 its only subgroup is alcohol fermentation equipment
criteria.Pr_60 Services and process source produc: Plant that produces, stores or treats what a building service distributes: boilers, burners, chillers and cooling towers, water heaters, heat exchangers, air-handling units, heating and cooling coils, tanks, cylinders and vessels, water treatment, generators, transformers, switchgear, switchboards and distribution boards, batteries, communications source equipment. Revit: Mechanical Equipment, Electrical Equipment
criteria.Pr_65 Services and process distribution: Products that carry a service from source to outlet: pipes, tubes, hoses and hose reels with their fittings, drainage gullies and channels, pumps, valves, ductwork and duct fittings, duct dampers, fans, sound attenuators, air filters, cables, cable trays, conduit and trunking, socket outlets, switches and other wiring accessories, gutters, chutes, lifts, escalators and conveyors. Revit: Pipes, Pipe Fittings, Pipe Accessories, Ducts, Duct Fittings, Duct Accessories, Flex Ducts, Cable Trays, Conduits
criteria.Pr_70 Services and process outlet produc: Products where a service reaches the space: air terminals, diffusers and grilles on ducts, fan coil units, split and VRF indoor units, heat emitters, radiators and heat pumps, luminaires and lamps, sprinkler heads, nozzles and hydrants, water inlets and outlets, flues and chimneys, communications products. Revit: Air Terminals, Lighting Fixtures, Sprinklers
criteria.Pr_75 Services and process control produ: Products that sense, switch or control a service: fire detection and alarm devices such as smoke and heat detectors, call points, sounders and alarm panels; intrusion and security devices; actuators, controllers, sensors and detectors, control and indicator panels; motors and motor controls; opening control products. Revit: Fire Alarm Devices, Security Devices
criteria.Pr_80 Services and process general produ: General products used across services: meters, flowmeters and measuring products; equipment boards, racks, enclosures, cabinets and housings; lighting columns and bollards; pipe and duct insulation and its casing; vibration isolation
criteria.Pr_82 Vehicle products: Vehicles: road-based vehicles and railway vehicle products
criteria.Pr_85 Process engineering products: Process engineering: environmental process products, engines and hydraulic power components, milling products, robotic products
criteria.Pr_90 Soft facility management products: Soft facility management products. Uniclass group title only: version 1.43 publishes no subgroups under it
